title: EmbedTicketsToEmbedder
description: Body of POST /v1/embeddings, the embeddings request process-issues sends for one batch of embed texts (architecture §7), exactly as sent. A batch is at most 2,048 texts whose UTF-8 lengths add up to at most 300,000 bytes, a safe bound on the API's per-request token limit; the API key goes in the Authorization header.

input.description: The embed texts, in order; the response holds one vector per text. Never logged or stored.

dimensions.description: How many values each vector has.

encoding_format.description: Vectors come back as JSON numbers.
